evidence_items.explanation: This supports limited end-to-end automation on the sampled remote-work projects. Those projects do not provide a representative denominator for all tasks in typical occupations.

This challenges a blanket characterization of poor professional-task performance. A win-or-tie rate on selected, well-specified knowledge-work tasks is not a representative occupational completion rate or a repeated-reliability measure.
